summary: Frontend-only testing of DM 37/2008 CNA-faithful DiCo & DiRi plus new form fields. Mobile viewport 390x844. All targeted testIDs are present and wired. Profile new fields (settore/civico/artigiani_numero) persist via AsyncStorage (dico_company) and are prefilled after reload. DiCo wizard: step 0 civico, step 1 intervento 'altro' reveals dico-intervento-altro, uso-* radios all render, step 2 progetto radios (prog-responsabile/prog-progettista/prog-nessuno) render with dico-progettista revealed on 'progettista', step 3 new attachment 'att-attestazione_non_normalizzati' is present. Document detail segmented model-cna (default) / model-app toggles without crashing; export-pdf-button visible for both. Edit flow repopulates civico=7B, intervento_altro='sostituzione caldaia', progettista='Ing. Rossi'. DiRi wizard: diri-richiesta, diri-civico, diri-descrizione, diri-anno (filter: '19a9b9c0abc' -> '1999' which is digits-only truncated to 4 chars - BEHAVIOR CORRECT), uso-* radios, both diri-att-relazione_verifica and diri-att-certificato_requisiti are checked by default (verified via screenshot), diri-allegati-altro writes to doc. Edit flow prefills all DiRi fields. cna-html.ts code review confirms all new fields are rendered (settore/civico/artigiani_provincia/artigiani_numero in company header, intervento_altro, uso_edificio row, progetto_da branch, diri-allegati row, anno_realizzazione boxes, richiesta_di). PDF HTML output not programmatically captured (expo-print iframe not inspectable on web) - verified by code review of /app/frontend/src/pdf/cna-html.ts.

action_items: Non-blocking: on-device validation needed for the CNA PDF model (visually confirm layout matches the uploaded DiCo/DiRi CNA templates when exported from an actual Expo build - web preview cannot inspect expo-print iframe output).

Minor polish (optional): default checked attachment 'certificato_requisiti' is now shared between DiCo (ATTACHMENTS list) and DiRi (DIRI_ALLEGATI) with same key - both wizards keep independent state via `allegati` (DiCo) and `diri_allegati` (DiRi) so no collision, OK as-is.
critical_code_review_comments: profile.tsx: new fields are plumbed through form state and persisted via useSaveCompany; prefill works via useEffect([company]) spreading {abilitazioni: [], ...company}.

dico.tsx: new state intervento_altro, uso_edificio (default 'civile'), progetto_da (default 'responsabile'), progettista_nome, progettista_albo are serialized into data and prefilled from existing.data on edit - all round-trip correctly.

diri.tsx: new state uso_edificio, descrizione_impianto, anno_realizzazione (digit-filtered via replace(/\D/g,'').slice(0,4)), richiesta_di, diri_allegati (default both checked), allegati_altro all round-trip correctly.

document/[id].tsx: segmented control switches between generateCnaHtml and generateHtml via `model` state; useEffect depends on [doc, company, model] so switching re-renders html (preview text is a web-only hint since expo-print opens Print API).
cna-html.ts: single-page CNA layout uses f() for underlined fields and cb() for checkbox marker characters - all new wizard fields are mapped correctly.
No deprecated expo packages introduced; no new UI issues; all testIDs listed in the review request are present and functional.

success_rate.frontend: All targeted UI flows and testIDs pass end-to-end (profile persistence + reload prefill, DiCo wizard full happy-path + edit prefill, DiRi wizard full happy-path + edit prefill, document detail model switch, both export buttons present).
